blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — Microsoft Outlook suffered a major outage across multiple regions Thursday, with tens of thousands of users struggling to access their email as the company said it was working “aggressively” to reduce the impact. Microsoft attributed the connectivity issues to “elevated load” on its infrastructure across multiple regions. The disruption also appeared to affect other Microsoft products. The company initially said it was investigating outage reports “in the Americas,” but later said it had “confirmed the issue may affect Microsoft 365 service connectivity for users in any region.” READ: Microsoft reports gains from cloud and AI investments Microsoft […]...
